title: Study of Evaluation Indexes for Antibody Production in Sera After Immunization
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate analytical methods such as ELISA and OPKA that measure the activity of vaccine-induced pneumococcal antibodies. After validation of ELISA and OPKA, pneumococcal antibodies were measured by ELISA and OPKA in paired samples before and after immunization (pneumococcal PS vaccine) in children, adults and elderly.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* elderly subjects over the age 65 years who had not received pneumococcal vaccination
* adult subjects under the age of 45 years (healthy volunteers with no previous history of pneumococcal vaccination)
* children subjects over the age of 2 years with no previous history of pneumococcal vaccination

Exclusion Criteria:

* immunocompromised, asplenia, cancer, liver or renal failure, and history of hypersensitivity to vaccine
